vertStrideDesc: 4 float16 per vertex = clip-space gl_Position xyzw (ATTR0 passthrough)
headerLayout: magic[4]=WSQ1, u32 frameCount, u32 gridN=128, u32 vertStride=4, u32 format(1=f16)
vertOrder: row-major by grid index (same ordering as wave_geo.bin); positions only
normalsUVsource: static from wave_geo.bin (cols 4:7 normal, 7:9 uv); lighting unchanged across frames
playback: interpolate linearly between consecutive keyframes; each keyframe spans 3 source frames (50ms at 60fps). Total forward span ~2.62s.
loop: PING-PONG: play keyframes 0..N-1 forward then N-1..0 reverse. Source is a continuous organic swing (does not return to frame0), so ping-pong gives a seamless ~5.23s loop. Velocity is near-continuous; optional ease at turnaround.
